The '''9G Explorer Droid''' was a model of [[Explorer droid/Legends|explorer droid]] manufactured by [[DeepSpace]]. The model was 1.3-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall automaton was designed to quickly investigate new-found [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and determine their habitability.
